## Checklist

- [ ] The post is public and I opened it.
- [ ] The prompt is quoted only as the author published it. I did not reconstruct it.
- [ ] The author, handle, and UTC date match the post.
- [ ] The result is visible without logging in, or it is an X post covered by `.lycheeignore` and `scripts/check_x_posts.py`.
- [ ] One creation only. An Opus 5.5 link is present only if that output was published with the same prompt.
- [ ] I did not upload anyone else's media.
- [ ] I regenerated `README.md` and `assets/social-preview.png` with `python3 scripts/build_readme.py`.
